verdict.rationale: Superpowers is fully open-source (GitHub repo) and its skills are installed and run entirely locally within whatever agent harness you already run (Claude Code, Devin, Hermes, Codex, etc.) via git clone or plugin install, meaning there's no cloud service to depend on — evidence of harness-agnostic 'skills/' as source of truth and multi-harness install instructions supports this. However, there's no explicit documentation framing this as 'self-hosting' or describing any server/infra component to host, since it's not a hosted service at all. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting/deployment guide, any discussion of infra/server components, independent confirmation of running fully offline/air-gapped.
